## Rallye Sahara Draâ (`morocco-sahara` 0.1.0)

Pack licence: GPL-2.0-or-later — TrackRS contributors

* `pack.json` (data): TrackRS contributors

* `textures/signs/*` (texture): Fictional bilingual event signs baked by tools/bake_sahara_signs.py (TrackRS contributors); lettering set in Noto Sans and Noto Naskh Arabic (SIL OFL 1.1, The Noto Project Authors). Arabic text unreviewed (verified:false in signs.json).
